producer.writes: An enactment action, a legislation.measure-enacted event and a record in history.legislativeEnactments. Nothing about the world itself.
producer.runsDetail: Every bill that passes in play goes through it.

readers.reads: Adopts an enacted tax and schedules collection. Collection works in Alaska only: src/fiscal-authority/tax-powers.generated.json holds one jurisdiction.
Records an appropriation as a public program, read by openAppropriationsFor at state-governing.ts:973.
Transit service hours, the one causal mechanism the production boundary allows.
Candidacy, term-limit and capability rules read an enacted rule change, but see the missing producer below.

missing.reader: A measured effect on the world: prices, jobs, coverage, crime, anything a law is about
missing.detail: assertProductionCatalogBoundary (production-catalog.ts:165) refuses every world metric except campaign support and transit hours, and every causal mechanism except transit's. ChatGPT answered the model (passage, effective rule, covered base, actual payment or service, scoped aggregate response); nothing is built from it.

missing.reader: People learning what a bill is about, so they can form a view on it
missing.detail: Four callers of introduceMeasure attach propositionIds (legislation-docket.ts:963, legislation-world.ts:451, legislation-bundle-docket.ts:356, legislative-clock.ts:730). The only reader is the integrity check at legislation-integrity.ts:156. recordPropositionExposure has no caller outside demo.ts, so a bill never exposes anybody to its question.

missing.reader: A law changing a rule of government, such as a term limit or a filing requirement
missing.detail: The readers are finished (candidacy.ts:363, executive-term-limits.ts:175). The producers are not reached: fileRuleChangeProvision has no caller, and the constitutional workspace only creates proposal-threshold changes (ConstitutionalWorkspace.tsx:91-95).

missing.reader: An income tax in the other 51 places
missing.detail: Collection needs a tax power for the jurisdiction, and the generated file carries only US-AK with no script that writes it.
